text: Six designs available: dgp1_linear Linear CATE \(\tau(x) = \beta'x\); logistic propensity. Correctly specified OLS-interaction benchmark. dgp2_nonlinear Sharpened nonlinear CATE \(\tau(x) = 0.5 + 0.75\sin(1.5 x_1)\); propensity. Misspecified OLS; primary horse-race DGP. Default target interior point \(x_0 = (1,0,\ldots)\) local CATE visibly nonlinear around evaluation point. dgp3_sparse_overlap \(\tau\) DGP 2; propensity interpolates 0.5 x0 much sharper near-boundary logistic far x0, using tighter Gaussian overlap pocket. Tests estimators adapt local effective sample size. Default target interior point \(x_0 = (1,0,\ldots)\). dgp4_clustered \(\tau\) propensity DGP 2; covariates three-component mixture: 80\ x0) plus two diffuse 10\ \((4.5,2,0,\ldots)\) \((-2.5,-2,0,\ldots)\) covariance \(1.25^2 \). Tests density adaptivity: DNN s-NN bandwidth automatically shrinks dense x0, fixed-bandwidth kernel -smooths. Default target interior point \(x_0 = (1,0,\ldots)\) inner cluster recentered . dgp5_correlated Covariates \(X \sim N(0,\Sigma)\) \(\Sigma_{12} = \rho = 0.85\); \(\tau(x) = \sin(2x_1) + 0.5x_1^2\); evaluation point \(x_0 = (0.75, 0)\). Tests shape adaptivity: L2 diagonal-scaled neighbourhoods misaligned elliptical covariate isocontours; dnn_oracle_mahal benchmark (Mahalanobis distance) corrects -diagonal covariance. dgp6_nuisance_efficiency Propensity \(e(x) = \operatorname{logit}^{-1}(1.25(x_1 - 1) - 0.75x_2)\) marginal regression \(m(x) = 1 + 1.5(x_1 - 1) - x_2\) aligned simple benchmark nuisance models, \(\tau(x) = 0.5 + 0.60\sin(1.5 x_1)\) remains nonlinear. Tests precision gap dnn_fullsample dnn_crossfit. Default target \(x_0 = (1,0,\ldots)\).
